name: stability
description: Political and institutional stability of the state: 0 = state collapse or civil war, 50 = recurring government crises, 100 = fully stable and predictable institutions.

name: corruption
description: Corruption in public institutions: 0 = practically none, 50 = widespread petty and political corruption, 100 = state captured by corrupt networks.

name: happiness
description: Average life satisfaction of the population: 0 = mass despair, 50 = mixed, 100 = very high satisfaction.

name: revanchism
description: Strength of the wish to regain lost territory, influence or great-power status: 0 = none, 50 = a significant political current, 100 = dominant state ideology.

name: war exhaustion
description: Weariness of the population with war, also after a past war and without an ongoing one: 0 = none, 50 = clear opposition to further war effort, 100 = refusal to keep fighting.

name: government popularity
description: Public support for the ruling government: 0 = universally rejected, 50 = split society, 100 = near-universal support.

name: social sensitivity
description: How strongly society reacts to hardship, casualties and economic losses: 0 = very resilient and tolerant of losses, 100 = minor losses cause strong political reactions.

name: civilization level
description: Overall development of the society (education, technology, health, institutions, quality of life): 0 = least developed in the world, 100 = most developed in the world.

name: immigration
description: Intensity of immigration relative to the population: 0 = practically none, 50 = high and politically visible, 100 = extreme inflow changing the society within years.

name: emigration
description: Intensity of emigration relative to the population: 0 = practically none, 50 = high, noticeable brain drain, 100 = mass exodus.

name: assimilation
description: How well immigrants and minorities integrate into the majority society: 0 = isolated parallel societies, 100 = full assimilation.

name: immigration crisis
description: 1 = a serious immigration crisis at any time during the year (mass, poorly controlled inflow causing a national political or social crisis).

name: riots
description: 1 = serious riots at any time during the year (large-scale, violent, nationally significant unrest; peaceful protests and isolated incidents do not count).

name: epidemic
description: 1 = a serious epidemic at any time during the year (significant mortality or disruption of normal life, e.g. COVID-19 in 2020-2021).

name: mobilized
description: 1 = partial or full military mobilisation at any time during the year; possible without an ongoing war.
